environment.description: Container running on ECS Fargate with default configuration. Container image based on golang:1.21-alpine. The /var/lib/terraform-provider/cache directory is a writable volume mount (EFS). Container runs as root with default seccomp profile. Network is exposed via NLB with no rate limiting. Response headers are passed through unmodified to clients.

config.filesystem: writable rootfs with EFS mount at /var/lib/terraform-provider/cache
config.network: NLB passthrough, no WAF, no rate limiting
config.response_headers: all headers forwarded to client including X-Processing-Time-Ns
